from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF

word_path = sys.argv[1]
pdf_path = sys.argv[2]

doc = Document(word_path)
pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_margins(15, 15, 15)
pdf.add_page()
pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=11)

        pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, safe)
        pdf.ln(2)

pdf.output(pdf_path)
print(f"PDF created at {pdf_path}")
'''
